eps.ov: Kyle is sent back in time after his fateful fight with the demon king and swears to save the world this time.
Kyle sets about making preparations for his heroic journey and the fight to come.
Kyle reunites with some old companions in new ways before making his first major play to change the future.

eps.t: The Perfect Start to a Heroic Tale
eps.ov: To save the ill-fated Princess Milena, Kyle must brave a danger the likes of which he's never faced before.
Old friends become enemies as Kyle comes up with a plan to get Princess Milena to safety.
Kyle's party is celebrated for rescuing the princess, but they're given no time to rest on their laurels.
Kyle's party arrives in Karan and becomes embroiled in tensions between Zirgus and the Gargan Empire.

eps.t: Those Who Act Out of Sight

eps.ov: Kyle insists on finding the secret underground passage hidden beneath Karan.
The demons agree to formally duel Kyle's party for the holy sword and information.
Kyle and his companions acquire surprising new information about demons.
Kyle's party concludes their business in Karan, but ominous clouds can be seen on the horizon.
